viewer.title: GPX track
viewer.fileMissing: The file for this track is missing. Go back to the run details and delete or replace it.
viewer.unreadable: The track data could not be read. The summary is still available in the run details.

profile.title: Elevation profile
profile.label: Elevation profile. Use the arrow keys to move along the route; Home and End jump to the start and the end.
profile.noElevation: This track has no elevation data.

warnings.title: Notes about this file
warnings.timestampsIgnored: The timestamps in the file were not usable, so time and pace are not available.
warnings.noElevation: The file has no elevation data, so there is no elevation profile, gain or loss.
warnings.multipleSegments: The file has several segments; gaps between them are not counted in the distance.
warnings.routeConverted: The file contains a planned route rather than a recorded track.

section.title: GPX files
section.empty: No GPX file yet. Add a planned course before the run or a recorded track after it.
section.notProcessed: This file has not been processed, so it cannot be shown on the map. Replace it with a new upload.
section.failed: This file could not be processed. Replace it with a new upload.
section.fileMissing: The file is missing. Delete this entry or replace it with a new upload.

toast.gone: This GPX file no longer exists.

delete.title: Delete this GPX file?
delete.description: The {{kind}} "{{file}}" will be deleted. The run itself stays. This cannot be undone.

upload.title: Add a GPX file
upload.description: The file is checked and measured on the server. Nothing in the run changes until you review the values and save.

kindHint.PlannedCourse: The route you intend to run. It is drawn dashed on the map.
kindHint.RecordedTrack: What your watch recorded. Its distance, time and elevation can fill in the run.

upload.replaceNotice: This run already has a file of this kind ("{{file}}"). Uploading replaces it.
upload.progress: Uploading and processing the file. Large files can take a few seconds.

replace.title: Replace the existing file?
replace.description: The {{kind}} "{{file}}" will be replaced by the new file and cannot be restored.
replace.descriptionUnknown: This run already has a {{kind}}. It will be replaced by the new file and cannot be restored.

prefill.title: Use values from the GPX file
prefill.description: Review what "{{file}}" proposes for this run.
prefill.notSaved: Tick what you want to use. The values open in the edit form, and nothing is saved until you press Save there.
prefill.restDay: Rest days have no distance, time or elevation, so there is nothing to fill in.
prefill.nothing: The run already has the values from this file.
prefill.completeHint: The run has happened: set its status to Completed.
prefill.dateMismatch: This track was recorded on {{trackDate}}, but the run is on {{runDate}}. Check that it is the right file before using the date and start time.

invalidGpx.malformedXml: The file is not valid XML. It may be damaged or cut off.
invalidGpx.dtdProhibited: The file contains a document type declaration, which is not allowed for security reasons.
invalidGpx.unsupportedFormat: This is not a GPX file. Only plain .gpx files are supported, not zipped or compressed ones.
invalidGpx.notGpx: The file is XML but not a GPX track or route.
invalidGpx.tooManyPoints: The file has too many track points.
invalidGpx.tooFewPoints: The file needs at least two track points.
invalidGpx.invalidCoordinate: The file contains a position that is not valid.
invalidGpx.tooComplex: The file is too deeply nested to be processed.
invalidGpx.wrongExtension: Choose a file with the .gpx extension.
invalidGpx.unknown: The file could not be used as a GPX track.

problem.exists: This run already has a file of this kind.
problem.limit: You have reached the maximum number of GPX files. Delete one to add another.
problem.restDay: Rest days have no GPX files.
problem.busy: The server is busy processing other files. Please try again in a moment.
problem.busyWait: The server is busy processing other files. Please try again in {{seconds}} s.
problem.storage: The file storage is not available right now. Please try again.
problem.storageWait: The file storage is not available right now. Please try again in {{seconds}} s.
problem.featureUnavailable: This feature is not available right now.
problem.unsupportedMedia: The upload was not understood by the server. Please try again.
problem.tooLarge: The file is too large. The limit is {{size}} MB.
problem.gone: This run or file no longer exists.
